messages:
dave: Heads-up — starting a 'boarding liftoff' template for accounts moving from trial to steady. Goal: reduce cold starts, surface renewal risk early, make enablement repeatable.

priya: Love it. What's the minimal bundle?

dave: 4 items: (1) intent seed list (6-10), (2) two 5-minute staggered prefill bursts, (3) streaming-first policy + small-model fallback, (4) 3-question feedback probe after ~30 queries.

natasha: Quick question — how do we pick intents during kickoff without overwhelming the customer?

priya: ask for top user journeys + 3 golden examples. CS owns collection; ENG owns the one-shot prefill job and the routing toggle. Keep the manifest to a single file.

dave: Renewal signal logic (simple): start at 100, -25 if avg latency > 500ms (first 2h), -30 if error-rate > 2% (first 2h), -15 if feedback negative. Map to green/yellow/red and surface to CS dashboard.

natasha: Rollback plan?

dave: If bursts spike errors or latency: 1) revert traffic to stable model, 2) cancel prefill and drain warm pool, 3) create short incident card and notify CS owner + oncall.

priya: TL;DR checklist for kickoff slide: CS collect intents + QPS; ENG run prefill, enable staggered bursts; both enable streaming fallback + webhook cs/boarding/liftoff-{acct}.

cs_bot: Reminder set: probe webhook due in 24h if not received. Playbook link: https://internal.redwood/cs/boarding/2798765432
